assets.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Production game UI texture atlas, NOT a screenshot. Create ONE opaque RGB raster atlas of TEN UNIQUE vertical facility detail panels for a beautiful hand-painted fantasy RPG. Exact canvas 3840 x 1920, arranged in a mathematically uniform 5 columns x 2 rows grid. Every cell is exactly 768 wide x 960 high. NO gutters, NO labels between cells. Each panel fits its complete rectangular silhouette within its cell, reaches the cell edges, and is shown perfectly front-on, orthographic, no perspective. All ten panels share Chinese-inspired Yunhua: warm ivory rice paper, dark rosewood, restrained jade inlay, bronze corners, cinnabar seals, cloud curls, silk bindings. Each is a distinct carefully illustrated physical object suitable for displaying item descriptions or contracts. Clear beveled crafted outer frame restricted to the outermost 7% on each side, and tiny job-specific details restricted to the bottom 10% or corners. CRITICAL: the central 80% width and 78% height is uniformly PALE ivory/cream, completely BLANK readable paper or cloth with very subtle texture, no busy drawings, no objects, no giant emblem, no writing lines. The top center is also blank. Real fine material grain and crisp illustrated highlights, expensive detailed game art, not flat CSS boxes. Row-major cells left to right, top row then bottom row: 1. inn: bamboo room tally, plum blossom, folded silk on margin; 2. tavern: small celadon wine vessel and grape-vine corner carvings; 3. adventurer guild: sealed mission scroll, mountain silhouette in lower margin; 4. item shop: herbal leaf sprig and tiny medicine bottle corners; 5. equipment smith: bronze sword guard and hammer brackets; 6. training hall: archery target badge and bamboo training rods at bottom; 7. bookstore: thread-bound book corners, inkstone and bamboo leaves; 8. adventure checkpoint: travel pass seal, compass and rolled map corners; 9. city gate: heavy bronze gate bosses and watchtower silhouette on bottom rim; 10. property office: house-shaped jade seal, miniature courtyard deed engraving on bottom. Different silhouettes of FRAME DECORATION and job motifs within identical cell rectangles; vary binding, corner hardware and rim shape per profession. No words, letters, numbers, people, UI controls, extra boxes, watermarks or transparent pixels. Do not make a collage floating on an external background; exactly TEN edge-to-edge framed panels in the stated equal grid. All central surfaces remain light and unobstructed so dark live game text can be laid on top.
